The robot lineup

Tell us the job. We bring the robot that does it.

Cleaning, delivery, inspection, material handling — we find the robot that fits your site, install it, and fix it when it breaks.

Get a free site assessment

Every robot below, run by one company.

We rent you the robot, set it up, and stay on the hook for keeping it running.

Delivery robots

Wheeled robots that carry food, room service, lab samples, or supplies from point A to point B on their own — freeing staff from the back-and-forth.

Pudu BellaBot · Pudu KettyBot · Bear Robotics Servi · Keenon DINERBOT

Monthly rentalRestaurants, hotels, hospitals, offices

Cleaning robots

Floor-care robots that scrub, sweep, and vacuum large spaces overnight or alongside your crew — covering ground people would rather not.

Pudu CC1 · Gausium Scrubber 75 · Gausium Scrubber 50 · Gausium Vacuum 40 · Pudu SH1

Monthly rentalWarehouses, retail, airports, facilities

Autonomous mobile robots

Autonomous mobile robots that haul material across a facility, follow people-and-goods workflows, and slot into existing operations without fixed tracks.

Peer Robotics PEER 3000 · MiR250 · Locus Origin · OTTO 600

Monthly rentalWarehouses, manufacturing, 3PLs

Cobots

Collaborative robot arms that work safely next to people — tending machines, packing, and handling the repetitive tasks that wear a line down.

Universal Robots UR10e · Standard Bots RO1 · Doosan palletizer

Monthly rentalManufacturing, packaging, light assembly

Humanoid robots

General-purpose humanoid platforms for teams that want to pilot the next wave without buying into hardware that is still moving fast.

Unitree G1 · Apptronik Apollo

Pilot pricing — talk to usInnovation teams, pilots, R&D
